description: This file defines message loop classes used in Spark's RPC system with Netty, including shared and dedicated message loops for handling RPC endpoint messages with thread pools.

classes.name: MessageLoop
classes.description: Abstract base class for message loops used in Spark RPC, managing message processing and thread pool.

classes.name: SharedMessageLoop
classes.description: Implements a message loop serving multiple RPC endpoints with a shared thread pool.

classes.name: DedicatedMessageLoop
classes.description: Implements a message loop dedicated to a single RPC endpoint with its own thread pool.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the message loop, shuts down thread pool, and signals termination.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Posts a message to a specified endpoint.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Unregisters an endpoint and stops its inbox.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new RPC endpoint with the message loop.
